run_vlm_training: run a VLM training job with autotrain by specifying project name, data path, and model
register_vlm_subcommand: register the vlm subcommand parser with training, deploy, and inference arguments for argparse
create_vlm_command: create a RunAutoTrainVLMCommand instance from parsed CLI arguments using the factory function
validate_vlm_args: validate VLM training arguments including project name, data path, model, and backend requirements
deploy_vlm_model: deploy a trained VLM model using the autotrain deploy command with spaces backend
